scope: test fixture contract only; no real model request was made
formula: uncached input upper bound * input rate + max output tokens * output rate; divide by 1,000,000
unknown_usage_policy: When provider usage is absent or invalid, the runner charges/reserves the full bounded single-call reservation; no retry is attempted.
over_bound_guard: Input bound must be <= configured max input tokens; actual reported cost above the reservation is recorded as a failed decision.
independent_assertions: The fixture bound is pinned at 7,046 tokens and checked against the adapter bound.
Price arithmetic is recomputed directly from fixture rates and output cap, not read back from the adapter quote.
The route-wide full-input maximum is separately computed and shown as a larger bound.
Unknown-usage cost is asserted to the full bounded reservation.
